name: skillradar
description: Discover, parse, safety-scan, classify, rank, inspect, and route Codex tasks to high-signal agent skills.

interface.shortDescription: Find the right skill for every Codex task
interface.longDescription: Route Codex tasks against a bundled, safety-gated SkillRadar registry first, with network fallback only when local data is unavailable. Results combine task relevance, quality, security and maintenance signals.
defaultPrompt: Find and inspect the best safe skills for this task before starting implementation
